content.scenarioBrief: The learner is invited to a recurring status meeting that clashes with focused work and wants to decline politely without sounding uncooperative.

turns.text: I have added you to the weekly status meeting on Thursday afternoons. Does that work?
Thanks for including me. I am not sure I need to be there every week, though. Most of my updates are already in the shared document.
The team likes to hear updates live. Would skipping it cause problems?
I could send a short written update instead and join only when there is a decision that involves me. Would that still keep everyone informed?
That is reasonable. Let us try it for a month and see how it goes.
